title: Summarizer outage: Claude API 429/529 storm after deploy v2.14.0
impact: From 14:01 UTC about 31% of /v1/summarize requests failed with 503 and p95 latency rose from about 2.1 s to about 30 s.
trigger: Deploy v2.14.0 of summarizer, finished 13:59:40 UTC
root_cause: Prompt template v7 puts a per-request timestamp at the top of the system prompt, which invalidated prompt caching (cache hit ratio 0.90 -> 0.00), so every call sent about 4.3k uncached input tokens. Together with concurrency raised from 8 to 64, input tokens per minute (peak 524000) exceeded the 400000 ITPM limit, producing sustained 429 rate_limit_error responses.
contributing_factors: The new retry policy retries after a fixed 500 ms and ignores retry-after (18-30 s), multiplying load (retry storm).
Upstream 529 overloaded_error responses from 14:05 were amplified by the same retries; there is no fallback model or circuit breaker.
No alert on cache hit ratio or rate-limit headroom; the first alert fired 8 minutes after the deploy.
evidence: First 429 at 14:01:12, 92 s after the deploy finished.
cache_read_input_tokens fell from 3900 per call to 0 immediately after the deploy.
Retry log lines show delay_ms=500 while the API returned retry_after up to 30 s.
input_tokens_per_min peaked at 524000 against a limit of 400000.

timeline.event: Deploy finished; worker pool resized from 8 to 64

immediate_actions: Roll back summarizer to v2.13.2 (RB-004), or hot-fix SUMMARIZER_CONCURRENCY=8 and RETRY_POLICY=exponential_jitter_honor_retry_after.
Move the timestamp out of the system prompt (append it to the user turn) to restore cache hits.
Route overflow traffic to claude-sonnet-5-5 while 529s persist.
follow_up_actions: Add a CI check that fails when the system prompt contains volatile values.
Alert on cache read ratio below 0.5 and on ITPM above 80% of the limit.
Add a client-side token bucket sized below the organisation's rate limits.
Load-test concurrency changes against rate limits before rollout.
